0022600213.text: The Clippers (2-7, 0-4 on the road) visit the Suns (3-5, 3-2 at home) for the 10th game of the Clippers' season, with Los Angeles 13th in the West and fourth in the Pacific, six games back, while Phoenix is 12th in the West and third in the Pacific, 4.5 games back. The Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), and Isaiah Jackson is day-to-day with groin soreness and is a game-time decision, while Phoenix is without Mark Williams (shoulder surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and they split their 2025-26 series 2-2, with the Clippers winning the last meeting 117-93 in Phoenix on February 1, 2026.
